name: tw_iczn_sfga
author: sfborg/hive
description: TaxonWorks-derived validation rules for names governed by the ICZN (col__code_id ZOOLOGICAL). Each rule's description names the TaxonWorks class and method it is ported from. Statuses are matched as NOMEN ontology URIs in name.col__status_id. Relations are declared in hive_rules.json. Schema compatibility: SFGA v0.3.x.

rules.rule_name: Parent rank is higher than the rank
rules.error_message: The parent's rank must be higher than this taxon's rank.

rules.rule_name: Related name is in the family group
rules.error_message: Both names in a homonym, synonym, replacement or spelling relation must be family-group names.

rules.rule_name: Related name is in the genus group
rules.error_message: Both names in a homonym, synonym, replacement or spelling relation must be genus-group names.

rules.rule_name: Related names share the nomenclatural code
rules.error_message: The two names in this relation are governed by different nomenclatural codes.

rules.rule_name: Status belongs to the name's code

rules.rule_name: Invalid family has a substitute name
rules.warning_message: This family-group name is marked invalid, but no substitute name is linked. Treat it as a synonym of the valid name.

rules.rule_name: Family with a homonym type genus is invalid
rules.warning_message: The type genus of this family-group name is a later homonym, so the name is invalid. Record the status 'invalid: homonymy of type genus' (or another invalid status).

rules.rule_name: Family whose type genus has homonym status is invalid
rules.warning_message: The type genus of this family-group name has the status 'homonym', so the name is invalid. Record an invalid status for the family-group name.

rules.rule_name: Gender agreement set only on species-group names
rules.description: Ported from TaxonWorks TaxonNameClassification#sv_proper_classification with Latinized::PartOfSpeech applicable_ranks (app/models/taxon_name_classification/latinized/part_of_speech.rb).
rules.warning_message: Gender agreement (the part of speech of an epithet) applies only to species-group names.

rules.rule_name: Homonym has a substitute name
rules.warning_message: This name is a later homonym, but no replacement name is recorded and it is not treated as a synonym. Add a replacement name or a synonym link.

rules.rule_name: Replaced homonym is linked as a synonym
rules.warning_message: This later homonym has a replacement name but is not linked as a synonym. Treat it as a synonym of the valid name.

rules.rule_name: Name with homonym status is linked as a synonym
rules.warning_message: This name has the status 'homonym', but no substitute name is linked. Treat it as a synonym of the substitute name.

rules.rule_name: Infrageneric epithet has no special characters
rules.warning_message: The infrageneric epithet should contain only letters; a hyphen is allowed only as a single letter, a hyphen, then letters (for example c-album). Mark misspellings with the appropriate status instead.

rules.rule_name: Infraspecific epithet has no special characters
rules.warning_message: The infraspecific epithet should contain only letters; a hyphen is allowed only as a single letter, a hyphen, then letters (for example c-album). Mark misspellings with the appropriate status instead.

rules.rule_name: Variety or form described after 1960 is infrasubspecific
rules.warning_message: Under the ICZN a name proposed as a variety or form after 1960 is infrasubspecific and unavailable, unless before 1985 it was adopted as valid or treated as a senior homonym. Record the status.

rules.rule_name: Parent is a valid name
rules.warning_message: The parent's name has an unavailable or invalid nomenclatural status. Move this taxon to the parent's valid name.

rules.rule_name: Name not older than its family-group parent
rules.warning_message: This family-group name is older than its family-group parent. Within a rank group the parent should be the oldest name; check the years and the placement.

rules.rule_name: Name not older than its genus-group parent
rules.warning_message: This genus-group name is older than its genus-group parent. Within a rank group the parent should be the oldest name; check the years and the placement.

rules.rule_name: Name not older than its species-group parent
rules.warning_message: This species-group name is older than its species-group parent. Within a rank group the parent should be the oldest name; check the years and the placement.

rules.rule_name: Typified name is available
rules.warning_message: The typified name has an unavailable status, so it should not have a type designation.

rules.rule_name: Name has no special characters
rules.warning_message: The name should contain only letters; a hyphen is allowed only as a single letter, a hyphen, then letters (for example c-album). Mark misspellings with the appropriate status instead.

rules.rule_name: Primary type repository recorded
rules.warning_message: The repository (institution code) of this primary type or syntype is not recorded.

rules.rule_name: More specific status preferred
rules.description: Ported from TaxonWorks TaxonNameClassification#sv_not_specific_classes (app/models/taxon_name_classification.rb) and its subclass overrides.
rules.warning_message: This status has more specific sub-statuses. Choose the one that states the reason, for example 'nomen nudum: no description' rather than 'nomen nudum'.

rules.rule_name: Relationship preferred over status
rules.warning_message: This status can be used, but a name relationship (for example a synonym or homonym link) records the reason more precisely.

rules.rule_name: Missing part of speech

rules.rule_name: Missing primary type
